## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related Issue if there is one.

## Validation

Describe the build, tests, editor checks, or manual verification performed, including the environment. Identify checks that could not run and any existing failures.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility changes, asset dependencies, screenshots/captures, or follow-up work when relevant.

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Validation results and limitations are recorded above.
- [ ] Generated output, personal settings, and credentials are excluded.
